tests.description: An `is` test in an arm guard holds, so the arm matches and its binding is usable.
The first arm's `is` guard fails, so control reaches the next arm instead of exiting the match.
No pattern matches, so the wildcard arm runs.
A named type in a guard runs the type's validator: the adult matches the first arm, the minor falls through to the second.
In the match(x is pattern) form each arm condition is itself the guard, so an `is` there is lowered too.
An `is` expression used as an arm's caseValue lowers on both routes: the no-pattern-arms early return and the collectChecks literal case.
A guard on the `_` arm is evaluated: it runs when true, and the match matches nothing when false. `_` is a catch-all only when unguarded.
An arm whose pattern binds nothing folds its guard in with && rather than nesting an if; the guard still decides the arm.
tests.expectedOutput: ["literal arm, guard held","literal arm, guard failed"]
